name: ADE7953 Demo
info:
This flow demonstrates the ADE7953 single-phase multifunction metering IC.

**Continuous single-phase metering**: an inject node fires once per second into the periph-ade7953 node, which emits voltage, current, active power, and cumulative active energy for Current Channel A. A function node formats the four values as one line; a debug node prints them to the sidebar — the user sees a live single-phase energy-monitoring feed, with active energy visibly climbing over the session.

The chip is wired to the host over I²C at the chip's fixed 7-bit address 0x38; the calibration constants (voltage_gain = 251.0 V/V, current_gain = 30.0 A/V) are placeholders — replace them with the actual values for the external voltage divider and current sensor on your PCB.
